attchmntText: Anjani Portland Cement Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Anjani Portland Cement Limited filed newspaper advertisements regarding its Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter ended 30 September 2026. The results were published in Business Standard and Nava Telangana on 13 November 2026. Kesoram Textile Mills Limited and Kesoram Industries Limited also filed extracts of their Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026. These results were approved by their respective Boards of Directors on 12 November 2026. Naperol Investments Limited filed its Unaudited Financial Results for the same period, approved on 11 November 2026. Additionally, Naperol opened a special window for transfer and dematerialization of physical shares from 5 February 2026 to 4 February 2027. SPML Infra Limited filed its Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter ended 30 September 2026.

attchmntText: Anjani Portland Cement Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Anjani Portland Cement Limited announced that its Board of Directors approved the Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, on November 12, 2026. The standalone net loss for the half year was 34 lakhs, compared to a loss of 76 lakhs in the corresponding previous period. Standalone revenue from operations for the half year stood at 9,180 lakhs. The company reported a standalone net loss of 56 lakhs for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The auditor issued a review report stating nothing came to their attention indicating material misstatements. The meeting commenced at 4:30 p.m. and concluded at 5:05 p.m.
